extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: (1) One row had an invalid date format (rejected fix), (2) Three Region label variants (West , north, west) were normalized to valid labels, (3) One missing Region value was left as-is (rejected fix), (4) The Price column had a dollar sign and was successfully converted to numeric, (5) Two duplicate rows were detected but rejected for removal. Despite these issues, the Revenue column was consistent with Quantity × Price, and all other numeric constraints were met. The total revenue per month was computed using the remaining 67 rows. The results are: January 2026: $6,352, February 2026: $9,565, March 2026: $5,040, April 2026: $16,198, May 2026: $11,546, June 2026: $11,810.
